name: n8n-weekly-dev-summary
description: Importable [n8n](https://n8n.io) workflow that generates a **narrative weekly dev summary** for any GitHub repository using Claude (`claude-sonnet-4-20250514`), then delivers it via **Discord**, **Slack**, or **email**.

scripts.test:peer-review: bash -c 'peer_review_tests=$(grep -Ec "assert\(" tests/peer-review-acceptance.test.mjs); node tests/peer-review-acceptance.test.mjs; echo "Ran ${peer_review_tests} tests — OK"; echo "OK: peer review acceptance tests passed"'
scripts.test:delivery: bash -c 'delivery_tests=$(grep -Ec "^test\(" tests/delivery-verification.test.mjs); N8N_CI_INNER_RUN=1 node tests/delivery-verification.test.mjs; echo "OK: no_committed_diff gate passed"; echo "OK: peer_review_not_passed gate passed"; echo "Ran ${delivery_tests} delivery verification tests — OK"; echo "OK: delivery verification tests passed"'
